title: Molecular Emission from a Galaxy Associated with a z ∼ 2.2 Damped Lyα Absorber
question: Is a high-metallicity z~2.2 DLA toward QSO B1228-113 associated with a molecular gas-rich galaxy, and what is the multi-phase nature of the absorbing gas?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 6.9 uJy/beam; cube 0.15 mJy/beam per 43.2 km/s channel

what.value: VLBA 327 MHz core flux density of the quasar, used for covering factor

evidence.quote: (cite: Kanekar2009) used the Very Long Baseline Array (VLBA) to measure the core flux density of the quasar

what.value: Previous QSO flux used to scale SINFONI cube

evidence.quote: The final co-added data cube was scaled to match the previously measured flux of the integrated QSO spectrum (cite: Ellison2005).

recipe.method: ALMA pipeline in CASA, self-calibration in AIPS, natural-weighted continuum and Hanning-smoothed cube

recipe.goal: Derive CO line luminosity and total IR luminosity
recipe.method: Fit modified blackbody to 100.5 GHz continuum flux
SINFONI re-reduction, pseudo narrow-band image, Gaussian fit of Halpha and [NII]; Kennicutt & Evans SFR with TIR dust correction
M_mol from L'CO(3-2) with r31 and alpha_CO

recipe.goal: Fit absorption lines and HI 21cm spin temperature
recipe.method: MCMC Voigt fitting of UVES metal lines with tied components; GMRT 21 cm optical depth limit and covering factor
key_parameters: six components fit to Ni II 1741/1751; assumed 20 km/s FWHM Gaussian for 21 cm

evidence.quote: yields a dust-corrected SFR of $110^{+60}_{-30}$ M$_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$
dust-uncorrected star formation rate (SFR) of $3.9 \pm 0.4$ M$_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$
The $3\sigma$ lower limit to the DLA spin temperature is then $T_{\rm s} > 1895 \times (f/0.93)$ K.
resulting in an updated metallicity of ${\rm [M/H]} = -0.27 \pm 0.10$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and continuum subtraction method
Method of fitting the CO line and extracting flux (aperture or Gaussian)
Details of SFR-TIR dust correction calibration
score_reason: Public ALMA data and simple measurements, but imaging and fitting details are sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA project; main results are numeric (line flux, continuum flux), though some settings are unstated.
